notes: Safe local actions on this box: open a URL in the default browser, copy text to the clipboard, send a macOS notification. All run through the SAFE runner as literal argv — no shell=True, clipboard text travels via pbcopy stdin, notification text via oscript argv (never string-interpolated into the script source).

actions.description: open a URL (or file path) in the default browser/handler
copy text to the macOS clipboard (pbcopy stdin)
